overview: Pre-release incremental update to the NPC subsystem. Major themes: (1) new Push-mode separation steering system alongside Legacy, with extensive tunability; (2) entity effect awareness (new filter + conditions); (3) enhanced debug visualization (path waypoints, separation vectors, steering vectors, orientation hints); (4) inventory system migration from NPCEntity-owned to ECS InventoryComponent; (5) death system improvements (configurable death particles, instant item drops, deferred corpse removal timing); (6) spawn particles now support model-attached particles with target nodes; (7) performance optimizations via Reference-based collections replacing identity-hashing HashMap/HashSet; (8) schema generation refactored from event to static registration.

new_types.overview: 10 new types added across the NPC subsystem.

types.name: FeatureOverride
types.purpose: Tri-state enum (On/Off/Default) for overriding boolean feature flags in role configuration. evaluate(boolean defaultValue) resolves the override against a default. Used by the new separation system to control orientation hints, always-separate, and normalize-distances features.

types.name: NPCDescriptorsCommand
types.purpose: New /npc descriptors command that generates and saves NPC role descriptors to npc_descriptors.json. Calls NPCPlugin.generateDescriptors() and saveDescriptors() (both now public).

types.name: EntityFilterEntityEffect
types.purpose: Entity filter that checks whether a target entity has a specific active entity effect via EffectControllerComponent.hasEffect(). Cost tier: LOW (100).

types.name: BuilderEntityFilterEntityEffect
types.purpose: JSON builder for EntityFilterEntityEffect. Reads 'EffectId' asset reference, validates via EntityEffectExistsValidator. Descriptor state: Stable.

types.name: SelfHasEffectCondition
types.purpose: Decision-making condition that checks whether the NPC itself has a specific active entity effect. Uses BuilderCodec with 'EffectId' string field and EntityEffect.VALIDATOR_CACHE. Resolves effect index in afterDecode hook.

types.name: TargetHasEffectCondition
types.purpose: Decision-making condition that checks whether the NPC's current target entity has a specific active entity effect. Null-safe: returns false if target is null or invalid.

types.name: VisHelper
types.purpose: Centralized debug visualization utility. Provides renderDebugVector(), renderDebugVectorTo(), renderDebugSphere() methods with configurable color and opacity. Replaces inline debug rendering constants that were previously scattered across AvoidanceSystem. Constants: DEBUG_COLOR_STEERING_POST (green), DEBUG_COLOR_STEERING_PRE (red), DEBUG_COLOR_AVOIDANCE (white), DEBUG_COLOR_SEPARATION (blue), DEBUG_MIN_VECTOR_DRAW_LENGTH_SQUARED (0.01), DEBUG_VECTORS_SCALE (4.0), DEBUG_VECTORS_TIME (0.05), DEBUG_TRANSPARENT (0.24).

types.name: Role.SeparationMode
types.purpose: New enum within Role defining separation calculation modes: Legacy (original behavior) and Push (new distance-weighted push-based separation). Governs which algorithm blendSeparation() uses.

types.name: DebugSupport.PathWaypointVisData
types.purpose: Record(position: Vector3d, isCurrentTarget: boolean, isEndNode: boolean, isSeekTarget: boolean) for storing path visualization waypoint data. Collected by BodyMotionFindBase, rendered by RoleSystems.RoleDebugSystem.

types.name: NPCSystems.OnNPCAdded
types.purpose: New ECS system registered by NPCPlugin. On NPC entity add, migrates inventory to ECS InventoryComponent system: ensures Storage, Armor (DEFAULT_ARMOR_CAPACITY), Hotbar (3), and Utility (0) components exist. Calls inventory.migrateToComponents() and backwardsCompatHook().

separation_system_overhaul.overview: The NPC separation/avoidance steering system has been substantially reworked. A new 'Push' mode has been added alongside the existing 'Legacy' mode, with extensive new configuration fields. The separation computation is now split into distinct phases: distance accumulation, distance scaling, and optional orientation hint application.

changed_types.name: Role
changes: New enum SeparationMode { Legacy, Push }
New fields: separationMode, avoidanceFallCheck, useOrientationHint, alwaysApplySeparation, normalizeDistances

New separation tuning fields: separationSafeDistanceMultiplier, separationLegacySteeringStrength, separationPushSteeringStrength, separationPushDistanceWeightDefault/Target/Attacker, separationPushSpeedScale
Temp vectors renamed: separation -> separationTempDistanceVector + separationTempSteeringVector
New tracking: separationSummedCount, separationSummedDistances (Vector3d)
New steeringChanged flag with clearSteeringChanged()/setSteeringChanged()/avoidanceFallCheckRequired()
blendSeparation() now accepts rotation parameter, dispatches to computeSummedDistanceLegacy() or computeSummedDistancePush(), then scaleSummedDistanceLegacy() or scaleSummedDistancesPush()
New RANDOMIZE_OFFSET_MAX_DISTANCE (0.001) and MIN_SEPARATION_SUMMED_SQUARED (0.01) constants
ignoredEntitiesForAvoidance changed from HashSet to ReferenceOpenHashSet
Death instruction now checks matches() before executing
Interaction instruction now checks matches() before executing
New fields: deathParticles, dropDeathItemsInstantly, deathItemsDropped flag

changed_types.name: BuilderRole
changes: 13 new JSON configuration fields for separation: AvoidanceFallCheck, SeparationMode, SeparationPushSafeDistanceMultiplier, SeparationLegacySteeringStrength, SeparationPushSteeringStrength, SeparationPushDistanceWeightDefault/Target/Attacker, SeparationPushSpeedScale, SeparationOverrideOrientation/AlwaysSeparate/NormalizeDistances
DeathAnimationTime changed from raw double to DoubleHolder (expression-evaluatable), default changed from 5.0 to 1.5
New fields: DeathParticles (default 'Effect_Death'), DropDeathItemsInstantly (default false)
SpawnParticles/SpawnParticleOffset changed from raw types to AssetHolder/NumberArrayHolder
New: SpawnParticlesTargetNode, SpawnParticlesDetached fields
avoidanceMode changed from direct field to EnumHolder (expression-evaluatable)
generateDescriptors()/saveDescriptors() changed from protected to public
New getOverride() helper methods added to BuilderBase for FeatureOverride enum

changed_types.name: Steering
changes: New directionHint (Vector3f) and hasDirectionHint fields for orientation-aware steering
New methods: setDirectionHint(direction, rotation, forceOverwrite), setDirectionHint(rotation), getDirectionHint(), hasDirectionHint()
New fallback accessors: hasYawOrDirection(), getYawOrDirection(), hasPitchOrDirection(), getPitchOrDirection(), hasRollOrDirection()
New constant: DIRECTION_VECTOR_MIN_LENGTH_SQUARED = 0.1
assign(), equals(), hashCode(), clear() all updated to include directionHint

changed_types.name: GroupSteeringAccumulator
changes: New normalizeDistances mode: when true, distances are normalized before accumulation, overlapping entities get random jitter direction, and final sum is normalized if > 1.0
When normalizeDistances=false, retains original averaging behavior
New setNormalizeDistances() method

changed_types.name: AvoidanceSystem
changes: Debug color constants moved to VisHelper (centralized)
Null-safety: added role != null check before processing
Added clearSteeringChanged() call before avoidance/separation processing
blendAvoidance/blendSeparation now receive rotation parameter
New VisSteeringPre debug visualization (steering vector before avoidance)
VisOrientation debug flag for orientation hint visualization
Obstructed check moved inside the avoidance/separation block

debug_visualization.overview: Significant expansion of debug visualization capabilities, including path waypoint rendering, separation vector visualization, and steering pre/post visualization.

changed_types.name: RoleDebugFlags

New preset 'visMove' = {VisSteeringPost, VisTranslation}
Updated 'visDist' preset to include VisSteeringPre, VisSteeringPost, VisSeparationTargets, VisSeparationSummed

changed_types.name: DebugSupport

New methods: clearPathVisualization(), recordPathWaypoint(position, isCurrentTarget, isEndNode, isSeekTarget), getPathVisData(), hasPathVisData(), isVisPath()
New inner record: PathWaypointVisData(position, isCurrentTarget, isEndNode, isSeekTarget)
entityVisDataMap changed from HashMap to Reference2ObjectOpenHashMap
setDisplayCustomString/setDisplayPathfinderString now accept @Nullable

changed_types.name: RoleSystems.RoleDebugSystem
changes: New renderPathVisualization() method renders path waypoints as colored spheres with connecting lines

Path visualization shows: waypoints (small spheres), current target (medium sphere), end node (large sphere), seek target (red sphere), connecting lines between waypoints, line from NPC to first waypoint
DebugUtils.addArrow/addDisc/addLine calls updated from boolean to int flag parameter (FLAG_FADE)

changed_types.name: MotionControllerBase

Debug steer log now includes 'obstr=' obstruction state
New debug move log with position, motion, and obstruction state
VisTranslation rendering via VisHelper after executeMove

entity_effect_system.overview: New entity effect awareness added to the NPC system at three levels: entity filter (for sensors), decision-making conditions (for state evaluation), and plugin registration.

changed_types.name: NPCPlugin
changes: Registered new 'EntityEffect' entity filter type (BuilderEntityFilterEntityEffect)
Registered new 'SelfHasEffect' and 'TargetHasEffect' conditions (via Condition.java static initializer)
EntityEffect.class added to loadsAfter dependencies for role asset loading
Schema generation refactored: GenerateSchemaEvent replaced with SchemaGenerator.registerAssetSchema() static registration

onSchemaGenerate() method removed

changed_types.name: Condition (base)

Registered 'TargetHasEffect' -> TargetHasEffectCondition.CODEC

inventory_migration.overview: The inventory system is being migrated from NPCEntity-owned Inventory to ECS-based InventoryComponent. NPCEntity.createDefaultInventory() and setInventorySize() are removed. A new OnNPCAdded system ensures InventoryComponent sub-components exist.

changed_types.name: NPCEntity
changes: Removed createDefaultInventory() method
Removed setInventorySize(int, int, int) method
Removed import of Inventory class

changed_types.name: NPCSystems.OnNPCAdded

Ensures InventoryComponent.Storage, Armor, Hotbar, Utility components exist
Calls inventory.backwardsCompatHook(holder)

changed_types.name: EntityFilterInventory

Uses InventoryComponent.getCombined(store, targetRef, HOTBAR_UTILITY_CONSUMABLE_STORAGE) instead

changed_types.name: ActionInventory

changed_types.name: RoleBuilderSystem

Ensures CachedStatsComponent on NPC entity add
spawnEffect() now passes holder and builderSupport parameters

death_system_improvements.overview: Death item drops can now be deferred to corpse removal time rather than happening instantly on death. Death particles are now configurable per-role.

changed_types.name: NPCDamageSystems.DropDeathItems

Now ticks every frame checking DeferredCorpseRemoval.shouldRemove()
Added system dependencies: AFTER DeathSystems.TickCorpseRemoval, BEFORE DeathSystems.CorpseRemoval
Respects role.isDropDeathItemsInstantly() - if false, waits for corpse removal timer
Tracks deathItemsDropped flag to prevent double-dropping
Query now includes DeathComponent.getComponentType()

changed_types.name: NPCSystems.OnDeathSystem
changes: Null-safety: added role != null check
DeferredCorpseRemoval constructor now receives deathParticles string

spawn_effect_improvements.overview: Spawn particle effects now support model-attached particles via the new SpawnModelParticles protocol packet.

changed_types.name: SpawnEffect

New methods: getSpawnParticleTargetNode(BuilderSupport), isSpawnParticleDetached(BuilderSupport)
spawnEffect() now takes Holder<EntityStore> and BuilderSupport parameters
